correctness.rationale: Exact three moment counts follow by conditioning on a prescribed isolated edge and counting allowed residual edges. For n>=5 and 3<=m<=C(n-2,2)+1, division by positive expectations yields K_n(m-3)/m and a rational cutoff strictly between consecutive integers, proved by explicit parity inequalities. Outside this range a statistic is identically zero. G(n,p) formula follows from overlap-only covariance; sparse limit follows from elementary hypergeometric asymptotics. Exact independent enumeration through n=6 and 3,955 assertions in CHECK.py passed. Boundaries, normalization and finite-versus-infinite proof distinction were checked.
